description: Add an executable onboarding harness that forces a new operator/assistant through the real Frame Conn development-tool authority model and verifies canonical, alternate-carrier, exception, recovery, and audit subsystems instead of merely reading documentation.
acceptance_criteria: npm run toolchain:onboard executes an ordered fail-closed onboarding drill rather than only printing documentation.

The drill covers Request Envelope, Mutation Carrier Router, Toolchain Orchestrator, Assistant Context Broker, Native Contract Catalog, Integration Surface Atlas, Runtime Signal Map, Clause-Aware Patch Corridor, Automatic Patch Staging, Corridor Context Pack, Patch Authoring Compiler, Runtime Contract Probes, Patch DSL, GitHub FilePatcher syntax, Toolchain Compatibility Staging, Change Propagation Simulator, repository audits, telemetry, and Failure Evidence Extractor in the authority order documented by the suite.

The drill separately exercises alternate/exception authorities including Domain Decomposer, Domain Decomposer Executor, Path Mover syntax, and Infrastructure Publisher without falsely presenting them as normal linear mutation steps.

The drill fingerprints authoritative documentation and prints hard assistant invariants forbidding manual repository reconstruction after READY, generic direct GitHub mutation, workflow/log inspection outside failure extraction, blind reruns of terminal failures, and post-SUCCEEDED reassurance work.
The drill writes a machine-readable receipt containing stage order, commands, exit states, documentation hashes, invariants, and terminal COMPLETE or FAILED state.

A lightweight --self-test validates the onboarding manifest, registered package scripts, authoritative documents, and required invariant coverage so Toolchain Compatibility Staging can certify this new developer tool.
non_goals: Mutate production Frame Conn source during onboarding.
Replace or bypass Toolchain Orchestrator, FilePatcher, Patch Corridor, or any existing authority.
Create a second planner, patcher, validator, or promotion path.
Treat alternate carriers or Infrastructure Publisher as normal FilePatcher substitutes.
Use GitHub workflow/job logs during ordinary successful onboarding execution.
raw_operations_reason: Failure evidence from add-toolchain-onboarding-drill-v1 shows Patch Corridor cannot architecturally classify developer-tool onboarding clauses and incorrectly maps them to gameplay runtime families; raw operations are therefore required only to bootstrap this dev_scripts/package.json tool transition while preserving all remaining canonical FilePatcher, Toolchain Compatibility Staging, propagation, audit, telemetry, and orchestrator gates.
